postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text:
HA-HA-HA WIPEOUT! 
 WAY TO STICK THE LANDING THERE, ACE.

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: PSST... LOOK ABOVE YOU! I'VE LANDED BESIDE THE SECRET ITEM THAT CAN BREAK THE SEAL ON THE ELEVATOR DOORS!

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: IT WAS SWIPED OFF OF A CUSTODIAN! I'M NOT SURE WHERE YOU EXPECT THEIR INVENTORIES TO TOP OUT.

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: IT SEEMS THE ITEM IS GUARDED BY A FIERCE PAPER JAM. IF YOU GET THE PRINTER WORKING AGAIN, I SHOULD BE ABLE TO ROLL IT TOWARDS YOU...

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: BUT BEWARE... MORVEN HAS NO DOUBT TRICKED OUT HIS LAIR WITH ALL MANNER OF UNSEEMLY TRAPS TO WARD OFF INTRUDERS.

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text:
PACHINKO MAN! 
 I FORESEE YOUR GREATEST CHALLENGE IS AT HAND!

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: HA-HA-HA WIPEOUT! WAY TO... UM. HOLD ON A SEC.

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: ANYONE ELSE GETTING SOME CRAZY DEJA VU UP IN HERE? UP IN HERE. NO? AW, C'MON! Y'ALL GONNA MAKE ME LOSE MY MIND. UP IN HERE.

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: UM. ANYWAY. THE JANITOR'S ITEM IS TRAPPED BY A PAPER JAM. YOU'LL NEED TO GET THE PRINTER RUNNING AGAIN TO LIBERATE THE BOTH OF US.

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: HA-HA-HA WIPEOUT! WAY TO - OH WHO AM I KIDDING, I'M BORED TO TEARS OVER HERE. CALL ME WHEN SOMETHING INTERESTING HAPPENS.

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: AW WILL YOU JUST BUY A STRATEGY GUIDE ALREADY?!

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: AMAZING WORK! I DON'T KNOW HOW, BUT YOU'VE BESTED MORVEN'S DEATH TRAP.

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: YOU KNOW... I'VE BEEN CONVINCED, ALL THIS TIME, THAT YOUR ACTIONS WERE GOING TO LEAD TO MY DEATH. BUT WE MAKE A GREAT TEAM, DON'T WE?

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: MAYBE... MAYBE OUR FUTURE ISN'T CARVED INTO STONE AFTER ALL. AH, BUT THIS IS PRATTLING FOR ANOTHER TIME.

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: GO AND GRAB YOUR FINAL ITEM! LET'S ESCAPE THIS MADHOUSE ONCE AND FOR ALL!

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: Howdy! I'm Mandy 1000. ^_^ I may be a stolen computer rusting in the bowels of hell, but I'm rarin' to help you out! What can I do for ya?
Printer troubleshooting
default_actions.label: Printing

default_actions.text: The latest computerized gossip
default_actions.label: Gossip

default_actions.text: Emoticon pointers
default_actions.label: Etc

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: Oh, that's not so hard. You need to start by unplugging some cords... the BLUE WIRE should be first. But never cut the RED ONE!

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: You should probably fill up the INK CARTRIDGE, too - just so long as it's AFTER you've cut those wires. KK?

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: I hate to say it, but one of the other computers down here always lies. Yeah! Most of what they tell you is the opposite of true.

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: It's definitely one of those other two guys next to me. Watch out!

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: You can put a capital 'd' after a colon and it will look like a big smile. That's a pretty good one.

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: Maybe an 'at' sign, a right arrow, and then a bunch of hyphens? That kind of looks like a rose. That's pretty charming.

default_actions.speaker: MANDY 1000
default_actions.text: I'm, uh, totally fine with this turn of events! Everything is fine! Let's sit here and not worry about it!

lens.speaker: MANDY 1000
lens.text: I'm not feeling blue! Things sure were worse before that Supply Thief swiped us...

default_actions.speaker: SHANTY 1000
default_actions.text: Avast, ye ball-shaped bilgerat! Shanty 1000 be the crustiest computer what ever sailed the seven servers. What ye be needin'?
Printer troubleshooting
default_actions.label: Printing

default_actions.text: The latest computerized gossip
default_actions.label: Gossip

default_actions.text: Tales of adventure
default_actions.label: Etc

default_actions.speaker: SHANTY 1000
default_actions.text: Ye be needin' to cut TWO WIRES before startin' the printer. Make sure ye cut the RED WIRE first - and don't cut the BLUE WIRE!

default_actions.speaker: SHANTY 1000
default_actions.text: Oh, and make sure the INK CARTRIDGE is filled BEFORE ye start cuttin' on any wires. It's smooth sailin' from then on!

default_actions.speaker: SHANTY 1000
default_actions.text: Another computer in this lot gets everything backwards. Ye can only follow their instructions iffin' you do 'em in reverse!

default_actions.speaker: SHANTY 1000
default_actions.text: We older models develop quirks like that as th' years go by. 'Tis surprising I'm still so normal! Yarr.

default_actions.speaker: SHANTY 1000
default_actions.text: 'Twas a dark 'n stormy night... the fluorescent lighting gone dimmer 'n I ever seen... the punch cards were angry that day, my friend...!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: This is less rip-roaring than anticipated.

default_actions.speaker: SHANTY 1000
default_actions.text: Shiver me pixels - she be comin' this way! Or he, not sure which pronouns boulders prefer. Regardless, AHHHH!!!

lens.speaker: SHANTY 1000'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: I'm feelin' green. Things sure were better before that Supply Thief swiped us...

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text: Hrmm... I'm Blandy 1000. A dusty ol' piece of stolen hardware. *sigh* What advice could you want from a rustbucket like me?
Printer troubleshooting
default_actions.label: Printing

default_actions.text: The latest computerized gossip
default_actions.label: Gossip

default_actions.text: Tearful poetry readings
default_actions.label: Etc

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text: Hmm. Before the printer is started, you need to cut TWO WIRES... the BLUE ONE should be first. Make sure you don't cut the GREEN ONE.

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text: Also you should also make sure the INK CARTRIDGE is filled, AFTER you've cut those wires. I guess.

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text: I happen to know that one of the other computers down here is partially colorblind. They can't tell blue from green.

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text: Frankly, it's a miracle that any of us are even still functioning. We should've been sold for parts years ago. *sigh*

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text: How did you know? Here's my opus, 'I upload lonely as The Cloud'.

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text:
If I, my love, could purloin your affection, / 
 I'd FATAL ERROR. NULL POINTER EXCEPTION.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: ...I think I ought to be going, now.

default_actions.speaker: BLANDY 1000
default_actions.text: We're all done for. Goodbye, cruel world! Thanks for nothing. *sigh*

lens.speaker: BLANDY 1000'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: I'm feeling blue. That Supply Thief sure swiped us before things were better...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I wonder why Morven had a squid plugged into this machine. That poor creature...
default_actions.cage: A fisherman said to me, today I didn't catch a thing. This summer's not going to be a good season.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: HEY, THAT REMINDS ME! I NEED TO ORDER S'MORE GIANT SQUIDS TO FEED TO MY PET LEVIATHAN.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.cage: Ah, this crazy world we live in, CAPTAIN JACK.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: C'MON, YOU KNOW YOU WANT TO ASK ABOUT IT. SPOILERS: I OWN A FISH BOWL SEVERAL TIMES LARGER THAN THE EPCOT GLOBE.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: C'MON, YOU KNOW YOU WANT TO ASK ABOUT IT. SPOILERS: MY AQUARIUM CONTAINS A PLASTIC CASTLE THE SIZE OF THE CHRYSLER BUILDING.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: C'MON, YOU KNOW YOU WANT TO ASK ABOUT IT. SPOILERS: IMAGINE THAT THING FROM 'CLOVERFIELD' HANGIN' OUT ON SOME FAKE CORAL.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: UM, I THINK THE SQUID WILL BE FINE. MIGHT WANT TO WORRY MORE ABOUT YOURSELF AT THE MOMENT.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Morven apparently hooked this sink up to the suckers on that squid's tentacles...

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: SO IT'S A SINK FOR INK. RIGHT? KIND OF AN INK SINK. COME ON, BACK ME UP ON THIS.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: I'VE GOT A SINK-ING FEELING... THAT YOU NEED TO GET CLOSER TO THAT PIECE TO INTERACT WITH IT. YOU DORK.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: I DON'T THINK THE INK SINK IS REALLY RELEVANT ANYMORE. BUT THANKS FOR THE OPPORTUNITY TO SAY 'INK SINK' AGAIN.

mug.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
mug.text: Should I dump my gross blood-mixture for some of this squid ink?

mug.speaker: BAAL
mug.text: DON'T COME CRYING TO ME WHEN YOU CAN'T GET PAST THE ROOM OF TRANSFUSION-BASED PUZZLES.

mug.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
mug.text: I think I'm pretty inked out at the moment.

mug.speaker: BAAL
mug.text: THAT'D BETTER NOT BE A TATTOO ALLUSION! OR EVEN A TATTOO ILLUSION. THAT WOULD BE EVEN SNEAKIER.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: MORE LIKE... INKLESS CARTRIDGE! 'CAUSE THAT THING LOOKS BONE DRY.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: That should do it! The printer's ink cartridge is filled to the brim.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: I'VE GOT AN INK-LING... THAT YOU NEED TO GET CLOSER TO THAT PIECE TO INTERACT WITH IT. YOU DWEEB.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN'S PRINTER
default_actions.text: The ink cartridge is currently in use! Please step back to avoid searing jets of ink-vapor. We'll target your eyes, I swear.

mug.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
mug.text: That should do it! The printer's ink cartridge is filled to the brim.

mug.speaker: BAAL
mug.text: I'M PRETTY SURE YOU JUST VOIDED SEVERAL WARRANTIES.

mug.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
mug.text: The printer's ink cartridge has been filled to the brim!

mug.speaker: BAAL
mug.text: I'VE GOT AN INK-LING... THAT YOU NEED TO GET CLOSER TO THAT PIECE TO INTERACT WITH IT. YOU DWEEB.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: There are wires of three different colors trailing from the printer.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: KIND OF REMINDS YOU OF THOSE BOMB WIRES THEY HAVE TO CUT IN THE MOVIES. LIKE, WHERE IF YOU CUT THE WRONG ONE, EVERYBODY BLOWS UP?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: GOOD THING FOR YOU THIS IS JUST A HARMLESS OLD CRAPPY PRINTER THAT A BUMBLING SUPPLY THIEF SWIPED FROM THE UPSTAIRS.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: SPEAKING OF, MY PRIVATE C-4 STOCK WENT MISSING LAST MONTH. YOU THINK MORVEN HAD ANYTHING TO DO WITH THAT?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: *gulp*
default_actions.cage: Got my first chemistry set when I was seven. Blew my eyebrows off. We never saw the cat again.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN'S PRINTER
default_actions.text: Printer in use. Do not disconnect your hardware. I will know about it and be very cross.

scissors.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
scissors.text: Which wire do I cut... which wire?!
scissors.cage: Whaddya say we cut the chit-chat, A-HOLE.

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: LET ME STRESS THIS FOR YOU... SCISSORS ARE NOT A PROJECILE WEAPON. GET CLOSER, OKAY?

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: PRETTY SURE YOU ALREADY CUT THAT ONE, ACE. JEEZE. SOME BOMB-DEFUSING ROBOT YOU'D MAKE.

scissors.speaker: MORVEN'S PRINTER
scissors.text: Printer in use. Do not disconnect your hardware. I will know about it and be extremely cross.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Hmm. There are two buttons printed on this control panel.
Print
default_actions.label: Print

default_actions.text: Reset
default_actions.label: Reset

default_actions.text: Don't press either
default_actions.label: SkipToEnd

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN'S PRINTER
default_actions.text:
Bzzzzzz! CHNK-CHNK-CHURRRR... 
 Your print job is now being attended to!

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN'S PRINTER
default_actions.text:
Bzzzzzz! CHNK-CHNK-CHURRRR... 
 Sequence incorrect! Cannot connect to the printer. Engaging DOOMSDAY PROTOCOL.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: ...WHAT?!
default_actions.cage: Maybe I shouldn't breathe so much, hu-HA!

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: OH. I GUESS THIS IS HOW YOU WIND UP KILLING ME. AND YOURSELF. GOOD JOB WITH THAT.

default_actions.epitaph: THE PRINTER EXPLODES INTO A FIERY MAELSTROM! I GUESS IT WAS RIGGED TO DO THAT IF YOU MUCKED THINGS UP. YEAH. QUIT MUCKIN' IT UP!

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN'S PRINTER
default_actions.text:
*click* 
 Reset routines initiated. 
 Engaging TIME TRAVEL PROTOCOL.

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: ...NKO MAN! I FORESEE YOUR GREATEST CHALLENGE IS AT HAND!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I've been sent back in time. Kind of a strange feature for a printer to have, but at this point I'm not really going to question it.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THE ONLY ONE PUSHIN' BUTTONS HERE IS YOU! MY BUTTONS, I MEAN. NOT THOSE ONES. THEY'RE TOO FAR AWAY.

default_actions.speaker: MORVEN'S PRINTER
default_actions.text:
Printing queue empty... entering sleep mode. 
 I wonder - will I dream?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Looks like a tunnel leading back to the 'surface' of Ball Hell.
default_actions.cage: One day I caught a cab and the driver said to me, today you're my first customer...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: This is the sort of thing Morven must've used to sneak off from his cubicle undetected.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THAT MANIACAL SON OF A... IF HE CROSSES MY PATH AGAIN, I WILL END HIM!! ...OR MAYBE PROMOTE HIM. IT'S A FLUID SITUATION.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I've got to find a way to get around all the obstacles blocking this exit... but how?!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THE REPELLANT SIGIL! DUDE, THIS IS SERIOUSLY POWERFUL MAGIC. ONLY A MASTER NECROMANCER CAN BYPASS IT!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Be that as it may... I've got to try!!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: There are a lot of smaller glyphs encircling the sigil... what should I do?
Press the sagittal glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the coronal glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the transverse glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Give up
default_actions.label: SkipToEnd

default_actions.text: Press the left anterior glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the right anterior glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the prime dorsal glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Give up
default_actions.label: SkipToEnd

default_actions.text: Press the sinistral glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the dextral glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the isotropic glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Give up
default_actions.label: SkipToEnd

default_actions.text: Press the septentrional glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the meridonial glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Press the phenomenal glyph
default_actions.label: PickRandomResponse

default_actions.text: Give up
default_actions.label: SkipToEnd

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text:
The glyph gave off a dull blue light... 
 What should I do next?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text:
The glyph didn't appear to respond... 
 What should I do next?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text:
The glyphs next to this one began to glow... 
 What should I do next?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text:
All of the other glyphs stopped glowing! 
 What should I do next?

ankh.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
ankh.text:
Wake up, Ankh Spirit!! 
 You need to help me get through this Sigil!

ankh.speaker: ANKH SPIRIT
ankh.text: Um. No, I really don't. I don't need to help you at all.

ankh.speaker: ANKH SPIRIT
ankh.text: Don't wake me up again, okay? I was totally scoring with the Godess of All Lies in my dream... *yawn*

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: OH FOR THE LOVE OF - REALLY? REALLY. YOU SMASHED THROUGH THE REPELLANT SIGIL WITH A GODDAMN CROWBAR.

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: FINE. YOU KNOW WHAT? FINE! YOU'RE HOME FREE. JUST SAUNTER ON OUT OF THERE, WHY DON'T YOU.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: IT'S A CAR DOOR. A LOCKED CAR DOOR! YOU'LL PROBABLY SET OFF THE ALARM IF YOU TRY AND GET PAST IT.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: AND THEN IT'LL WAKE UP ALL THE NEIGHBORS AND IT'LL ALL BE YOUR FAULT. YEP, BETTER JUST LIE DOWN AND ACCEPT DEATH.

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: THIS SEEMS LIKE THE EQUIVALENT OF KEYING UP SOMEONE'S CAR. WHICH IS AWESOME. BUT ALSO PROHIBITED!

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: OH, HUH! YOU'VE WRENCHED THE DOOR OUT OF YOUR WAY. BUT YOU'RE NOT OUT OF THE WOODS JUST YET...!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: IT'S A PILE OF CRATES! RUMOR HAS IT THAT YOU NEED TO PUSH THESE AROUND AND USE THEM TO WEIGH DOWN ALL THE SWITCHES IN THE ROOM.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Those crates are way too heavy to push. Also there ARE NO SWTICHES DOWN HERE.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: LOOK, I DIDN'T SAY IT WAS AN ACCURATE RUMOR! OR THAT I DIDN'T COMPLETELY FABRICATE IT A FEW SECONDS AGO.

scissors.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
scissors.text: No. I don't think scissors will be much help here. Otherwise I doubt anyone would have invented boxcutters.

crowbar.speaker: BAAL
crowbar.text: WHOAH! THE CROWBAR JUST TORE THROUGH THOSE CRATES LIKE BUTTER. NICE ONE. TOO BAD YOU'VE STILL GOT CRAP IN YOUR WAY!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Any chance you could use your future-powers to figure out how we'll get out of this, Eight Ball?

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: SORRY, WE EIGHT BALLS ARE MOSTLY ONLY ABLE TO REPORT VAGUELY ON ANSWERS TO YES OR NO QUESTIONS.

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: I CAN SAY THAT IT SEEMS THE ORDER IN WHICH YOU EXECUTE TASKS DOWN HERE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT...

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: I SENSE THAT OUR JOURNEY TOGETHER IS ALMOST FINISHED! JUST GRAB THAT CROWBAR AND LET'S ESCAPE.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Tony's lost item... a rusty old crowbar. Not the greatest motivator in the world, but hey, I've come this far.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text:
YOU PICKED UP THE CROWBAR! 
 THIS THING RADIATES WITH PRAGMATIC USEFULNESS. 
 ALSO TETANUS. PROBABLY.

Hee, hee... 
 You ought not've done that, y'know...

default_actions.speaker: DOOM SPHERE
default_actions.text: Not while I'M around...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Oh my gosh... Tragic Eight Ball! Say something!

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: R-REPLY HAZY... TRY AGAIN NEVER. *bleaghh*

default_actions.speaker: DOOM SPHERE
default_actions.text: Boss Morven was no ordinary petty thief, see? He built a TEMPLE to Petty Thievery.

default_actions.speaker: DOOM SPHERE
default_actions.text: And he created ME to CRUSH anyone what tries to dishonor that temple by stealing his sacred swag!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: D-doesn't stealing from a temple of thievery mean you are, in fact, completely honoring it?
default_actions.cage: I'm more like... a treasure protector.

default_actions.speaker: DOOM SPHERE
default_actions.text: I say it means this temple... is about to become a TOMB!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Tony's lost crowbar... I should get a little closer before picking it up.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: SO UM, HEY. I NOTICE YOU'RE BEING CHASED BY AN ENORMOUS LIVING BOULDER DEADSET ON CRUSHING YOU TO DEATH.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: YOU KNOW WHERE THERE ISN'T A LIVING BOULDER TRYING TO KILL YOU? BACK IN YOUR CUBICLE. JUST A THOUGHT.

collision_actions.epitaph: THE DOOM SPHERE FLATTENS YOU INTO A PACHINKO-PANCAKE. SHOCKING, YET INCREDIBLY APPETIZING!

scissors.speaker: DOOM SPHERE
scissors.text: Your weapons are powerless against me! CAN'T STOP THE ROCK!

stapler.speaker: DOOM SPHERE
stapler.text: Your weapons are powerless against me! NOTHING MOVES THE ROCK!

crowbar.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
crowbar.text: He needs to get closer before I can get a clean shot...!

lens.speaker: DOOM SPHERE'S THOUGHTS
lens.text:
I... I shall consume. Consume. 
 Consume a box of oreos. After I'm done crushing this guy.
